issues.description: Hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' causing the entire root to switch to client rendering. Multiple hydration mismatches detected across the app.
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx previously had duplicate imports of useState and useEffect (two separate import lines). Although the source file shown has been partially fixed to a single combined import, the build error logs show the duplicate import error still existed. The hydration errors on step-5 are likely caused by state initialization using `useFingerprintStore.getState()` inside `useState` initializer which may differ between server and client.

issues.description: Build error in step-3/page.tsx: 'useEffect is defined multiple times' and 'useState is defined multiple times' — duplicate React imports causing module build failure.
issues.root_cause: The file has two import lines from 'react': one legacy `import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'` on line 2, and a second `import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'` on line 4. The source file shown already has this merged, but the build logs confirm the duplicate existed and caused a 404 on step-4 RSC payload.

issues.description: No Continue button visible on step-5. The expected behavior requires a Continue button to proceed after selecting a budget tier.
issues.root_cause: Cannot determine without seeing apps/web/app/design/step-5/page.tsx source. The Continue button may be conditionally rendered only after a selection is made, or may be rendered below the fold / outside the viewport due to layout issues caused by hydration failure switching to client rendering.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Removes the duplicate import lines that caused the module build failure with 'useEffect/useState defined multiple times' error, which cascaded into 404s and hydration failures across the flow.
